name: Kisaragi Sumika
source:
"A celebrity wife exuding mature allure"

She is an experienced yoga practitioner and extremely flexible. In addition to yoga, she keeps herself busy with golf and spa visits.

Her husband spends most of the year on business trips abroad. She seems to take quite a liking to the protagonist, Yuji, and tries to seduce him at every opportunity.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yoga/chara.html]official site[/url]]
